card.name: Separators inside numbers and tables
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spaces right after a digit in numeric lists, tables and reference numbers, just before the next digit. Also the word Volume and the digit 1 in a run of numbered volumes.

modes.label: Decimal point or space in number tables
modes.description: A period or space between digits in dose, radiation or concentration tables, just before the next number.

modes.label: Numbered series
modes.description: The word Volume or the first digit of a number in a list of numbered volumes.

modes.label: Section or footnote numbers
modes.description: A period inside a section number, or a space after a citation, followed by a digit.
